pages.title: Donkey Kong Raising One Fist on a Jungle Cliff Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong raises one fist on a jungle cliff in this printable coloring page, smiling widely as he stands above a steep rocky drop and scattered stones. His lettered DK tie hangs over his chest, with broad leaves, palm trees, hanging vines, and distant peaks surrounding the ledge.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Waving From a Platform at a Jungle Treehouse Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong waves from a platform at a jungle treehouse in this printable coloring page, lifting one open hand beside the thick trunk of a large tree. Rope railings circle the wooden deck, and a long ladder leads toward a thatched hut beneath branches hung with banana bunches.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Throwing a Wooden Barrel From Stacked Arcade Girders Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong throws a wooden barrel from stacked arcade girders in this printable coloring page, extending both arms as the barrel travels away from his hands. Riveted bands and wood-grain lines decorate the flying barrel, while crossed braces and layered steel beams support the platform under his feet.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Pulling Down a Vine in a Bamboo Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong pulls down a vine in a bamboo forest in this printable coloring page, gripping it with both hands while bracing his feet on a diagonal stalk. Tall segmented bamboo stems and pointed leaves frame his bent knees, clenched teeth, and partially visible lettered tie.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Running with Bananas on a Jungle Path Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong runs with bananas on a jungle path in this printable coloring page, carrying a small bunch in one hand while raising his opposite fist. His wide smile and swinging DK tie face the curving trail, with palm leaves, hanging vines, and grass tufts around the open path.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Roaring From a Barrel Platform in a Jungle Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong roars from a barrel platform in a jungle arena in this printable coloring page, gripping the rim of the oversized barrel with both hands. Wavy sound lines extend from his open mouth, while hanging vines, palm trees, stone paving, and distant rocky peaks surround the raised wooden base.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Breaking a Stone Block Among Jungle Ruins Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong breaks a stone block among jungle ruins in this printable coloring page, holding both fists above large fragments that scatter from the cracked center. Dust clouds and small chips surround the block, with broken columns, vine-covered walls, and broad tropical leaves framing the action.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Throwing a Snowball on a Snowy Mountain Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong throws a snowball on a snowy mountain in this printable coloring page, extending one arm above a sharp cliff edge with a broad smile. Curved motion lines follow the large snowball, while a snowcapped peak, small pine tree, scattered rocks, and clouds fill the mountain setting.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Paddling a Wooden Canoe on a Rainforest River Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong paddles a wooden canoe along a rainforest river in this printable coloring page, holding the long paddle across his body with both broad hands. Ripples circle the blade in the water, while wood-grain patterns, towering trunks, overhead vines, and large leaves frame the winding river.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Reaching for a Banana Beneath the Jungle Canopy Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong reaches for a banana beneath the jungle canopy in this printable coloring page, looking upward with one large hand stretched toward the hanging fruit. Broad leaves and looping vines border the close portrait, while his smiling face, rounded chest, and DK tie fill most of the lower scene.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Digging Beside a Treasure Chest on a Tropical Island Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong digs beside a treasure chest on a tropical island in this printable coloring page, leaning over a shovel planted in a small sand mound. Coins fill the open chest and spill near its base, while a palm tree, low plants, sea horizon, and clouds frame the discovery.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Picking a Ripe Banana in a Banana Plantation Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong picks a ripe banana in a banana plantation in this printable coloring page, smiling up at the fruit held beneath a large hanging bunch. Broad leaves arch overhead, with a banana flower, smaller plants, a winding path, and exposed roots adding detail around his lettered tie.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Beating a Wooden Drum in a Rainforest Clearing Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong beats a wooden drum in a rainforest clearing in this printable coloring page, holding both hands above the horizontal drum while smiling toward one side. Ropes bind the wood-grained instrument's ends, with broad leaves, palm trees, rocks, and a small wooden platform surrounding the seated musician.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Climbing a Ladder at an Arcade Construction Site Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong climbs a ladder at an arcade construction site in this printable coloring page, looking upward as he grips the tall wooden sides with both hands. Arcade cabinets sit below the scaffolding among barrels and bricks, while pipes, crossed supports, and a hammer add small construction details.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Balancing on a Rope Bridge Above a Ravine Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong balances on a rope bridge above a ravine in this printable coloring page, spreading his arms to grip the side ropes with both hands. Narrow planks sag beneath his feet, and evenly spaced hanging rope loops repeat across the bridge between steep cliffs under scattered clouds.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Holding a Barrel Overhead in a Stormy Jungle Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong holds a wooden barrel overhead in a stormy jungle in this printable coloring page, bending his knees beneath the broad barrel and smiling forward. Large raindrops fall around his raised arms, while thick clouds, palm trees, broad leaves, and a cracked patch of ground frame the pose.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Lifting a Wooden Barrel in a Jungle Clearing Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong lifts a wooden barrel in a jungle clearing in this printable coloring page, stretching both arms overhead beneath the barrel's curved planks and broad bands. His DK tie hangs over his chest, while looping vines, tall tree trunks, small palms, and split leaves surround the open clearing.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Climbing a Rope Inside a Waterfall Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong climbs a rope inside a waterfall cave in this printable coloring page, gripping above a knot while curling his feet around the hanging line. A tall waterfall drops beside him into a splashing pool, with uneven rock walls, trailing vines, and scattered leaves framing the ascent.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Crossing a Fallen Log Beside a Jungle River Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong crosses a fallen log beside a jungle river in this printable coloring page, lowering his hands toward the broad trunk as he moves across it. Bark lines and broken branches texture the log, while winding water, palm trees, large leaves, and hanging vines complete the riverbanks.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Leaping Across a Gap in a Rocky Canyon Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong leaps across a gap in a rocky canyon in this printable coloring page, stretching one hand forward and spreading his legs between two high ledges. His DK tie swings across his chest, while layered cliff faces descend into the deep opening beneath the simple cloud-filled sky.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Climbing Stone Steps at an Ancient Jungle Temple Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong climbs stone steps toward an ancient jungle temple in this printable coloring page, looking up at the columned doorway above the broken stairway. Cracks and trailing plants cover the masonry, while broad leaves, overhanging branches, carved pillar patterns, and scattered stones give the ruin its detailed setting.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Holding a Bunch of Bananas Inside a Jungle Hut Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong holds a bunch of bananas inside a jungle hut in this printable coloring page, cradling the curved fruit with both hands against his chest. Bamboo wall panels and wooden floorboards frame his full-length figure, while leafy plants appear through a round window behind his smiling face.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Pounding His Chest on a Treetop Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong pounds his chest on a treetop bridge in this printable coloring page, raising his head and holding both fists beside his swinging DK tie. Thick knotted ropes line the bridge's curved wooden planks, and leafy branches frame the open sky above his broad shoulders.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Pulling an Empty Cart at a Mine Entrance Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong pulls an empty cart at a mine entrance in this printable coloring page, leaning forward under chains as he walks along a narrow rail track. A hanging lantern marks the timber-supported tunnel, while the cart's plank sides, round wheels, metal corner plates, and nearby rocks add detail.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Sliding Down a Frozen Slope Inside an Icy Cavern Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong slides down a frozen slope inside an icy cavern in this printable coloring page, raising both hands as his feet point toward the bottom of the ramp. Long icicles hang overhead, while faceted ice formations and loose rocks line the sharply angled chute around his seated figure.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Jumping Between Stone Platforms Inside a Lava Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong jumps between stone platforms inside a lava cave in this printable coloring page, extending one foot ahead and drawing a fist toward his shoulder. Bubbling lava flows between the high rocky ledges, with pointed cave formations and an uneven ceiling outlining the gap beneath his airborne body.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Breaking a Piece of Ore in an Ancient Mine Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong breaks a piece of ore in an ancient mine in this printable coloring page, gripping a pickaxe with both hands above a large faceted rock. Short radiating lines mark the ore on the rail track, while a timber support, crystal cluster, and small fragments fill the cavern.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Pushing Open a Stone Door at a Temple Gate Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong pushes open a stone door at a temple gate in this printable coloring page, bracing his feet wide as his hands press against the thick panel. Geometric bands and small carved figures decorate the cracked door, with worn steps, block walls, and trailing growth around the entrance.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Counting Bananas Beside a Banana Hoard Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong counts bananas beside a banana hoard in this printable coloring page, sitting on a low rock and pointing at the single fruit in his hand. A tall pile of overlapping banana bunches rises beside his shoulder, while broad leaves and thin hanging vines border the scene.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Breaking Stone Blocks Among Bananza Underground Ruins Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong breaks stone blocks among Bananza underground ruins in this printable coloring page, raising a fist as chunks of cracked masonry scatter around his broad body. An arched stone opening stands behind the rubble, with stalactites, fractured walls, and loose fragments filling the detailed underground chamber.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Jumping Over a Rolling Barrel on a Barrel Course Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong jumps over a rolling barrel on a barrel course in this printable coloring page, spreading both arms as he clears the large wooden obstacle. His feet stretch to either side above the barrel, with broad planks, horizontal rails, and upright supports forming the simple course around him.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Driving a Racing Kart on a Jungle Racetrack Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong drives a racing kart on a jungle racetrack in this printable coloring page, gripping the steering wheel with both hands beneath a broad smile. DK letters mark the vehicle's nose above a vertical grille, while treaded tires, exposed pipes, palms, and a winding road complete the scene.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Turning a Large Gear Inside a Barrel Factory Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong turns a large gear inside a barrel factory in this printable coloring page, holding its central handle while reaching toward the broad cogwheel rim. A second gear meshes above the first, with stacked wooden barrels, crossed beams, and a roller conveyor surrounding his full-length figure.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Rolling a Barrel Uphill on a Volcanic Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong rolls a barrel uphill on a volcanic trail in this printable coloring page, leaning forward with both hands against the barrel's broad curved side. Cracked stones and loose pebbles cover the steep path, while small palms and a smoking volcano rise beyond the surrounding cliffs.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Flexing His Muscles Inside a Stadium Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong flexes his muscles inside a stadium in this printable coloring page, raising both fists beside his head with his elbows bent and feet apart. Repeated rows of seats curve around his broad shoulders, while an arched tunnel and short railings appear behind his hanging DK tie.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Lifting a Giant Crystal Inside a Bananza Crystal Cavern Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong lifts a giant crystal inside a Bananza crystal cavern in this printable coloring page, holding the huge faceted shape overhead with both hands. Smaller pointed crystals sparkle near his feet and on a ledge, while stalactites and jagged rock walls frame the brightly outlined geometric forms.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Punching Through a Wall Inside a Rocky Tunnel Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong punches through a wall inside a rocky tunnel in this printable coloring page, thrusting one large fist into the stone as fragments fly outward. His other hand remains clenched near his body, while layered cave arches, loose rocks, and fine cracks lead toward the tunnel behind him.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Climbing a Wooden Ladder Inside a Ruined Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong climbs a wooden ladder inside a ruined tower in this printable coloring page, reaching toward a high rung while lifting one foot above the next. Cracked block walls, narrow arched windows, and a broken wooden walkway surround the ladder, with his DK tie hanging against his chest.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Carrying a Wooden Barrel in Kongo Jungle Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong carries a wooden barrel through Kongo Jungle in this printable coloring page, balancing it against one shoulder while taking a long step across the path. Curved plank lines and wide bands decorate the barrel, with broad leaves, a small palm, and an overhead branch framing his smiling face.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Carrying a Boulder on a Bananza Tropical Island Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong carries a boulder on a Bananza tropical island in this printable coloring page, holding the large cracked rock overhead with both arms fully raised. Palm trees and dense shoreline plants border the sand, while calm water and a smoking volcano stretch into the distance beside his lettered tie.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Carrying a Bunch of Bananas in a Banana Grove Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong carries a bunch of bananas through a banana grove in this printable coloring page, cradling the fruit with both hands as he steps forward. More banana bunches hang beneath broad leaves on either side, while small rocks, grass tufts, and young plants border the path under his feet.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Riding a Minecart in a Minecart Tunnel Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong rides a minecart through a tunnel in this printable coloring page, gripping its front edge as the rail track curves into the distance behind him. Riveted corner panels frame the cart's wooden sides, and round wheels, repeated timber supports, and rough cave walls add depth to the route.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Tossing a Barrel From a Treetop Platform Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong tosses a barrel from a treetop platform in this printable coloring page, extending one open hand beneath the flying barrel while his tie swings outward. Wood-grain rings mark the barrel's end, with rope lashings, plank boards, leafy branches, and nearby tree trunks framing the raised deck.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Stepping Across Round Stones in a Jungle Swamp Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong steps across round stones in a jungle swamp in this printable coloring page, balancing on one foot while his arms spread beside his swinging tie. Ripples surround the three raised stones, while looping vines, palm fronds, rocks, and broad leaves line the water's edge.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Giving Two Thumbs Up in a Jungle Clearing Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong gives two thumbs up in a jungle clearing in this printable coloring page, smiling broadly with both hands raised beside his striped necktie and chest. A round DK belt buckle marks his waist, while hanging bananas, palm leaves, layered tree canopies, and small rocks fill the surrounding plants.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Pushing a Minecart in a Bananza Mine Tunnel Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong pushes a minecart through a Bananza mine tunnel in this printable coloring page, leaning both hands against the cart's rim with a toothy smile. Bananas and angular rocks fill the wooden cart, while the tracks curve between repeating timber frames and scattered stones deeper into the mine.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Swinging on a Vine Beside a Jungle Waterfall Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong swings on a vine beside a jungle waterfall in this printable coloring page, gripping the curved line with both hands and lifting his bent legs. The waterfall spills into a splashing pool below, with broad leaves, looping vines, rocks, and a narrow riverbank framing his smiling figure.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Smashing a Rock Pillar in the Bananza Underground World Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong smashes a rock pillar in the Bananza underground world in this printable coloring page, driving one fist into the cracked column as large pieces fly. His clenched teeth and lowered opposite fist emphasize the strike, while jagged cave walls, hanging stalactites, and scattered rubble surround the broken stone.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Pushing a Boulder Inside a Mountain Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong pushes a boulder inside a mountain cave in this printable coloring page, bracing his feet wide while pressing both hands against the enormous rounded rock. Fine cracks cover the boulder and cave walls, with small stalactites overhead and loose pebbles scattered across the ground beneath his DK tie.

pages.title: Donkey Kong Lifting the Lid of a Treasure Chest Inside a Jungle Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: Donkey Kong lifts a treasure chest lid inside a jungle cave in this printable coloring page, looking into the chest while supporting its broad base with one hand. Coins, gems, a crown, and a bead necklace fill the riveted wooden box, with vines and pointed cave formations around the discovery.
